description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {B} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Imps' Taunt with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Imps' Taunt.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with four or more charge counters on it
